CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_can_manage_tournament_schedule(p_union_id uuid, p_club_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs c
     WHERE c.id = p_club_id AND c.lifecycle_status = 'active'
  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF p_union_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=p_union_id AND u.owner_id=p_user_id)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_admins ua WHERE ua.union_id=p_union_id AND ua.user_id=p_user_id);
  END IF;
  RETURN public.is_club_admin(p_club_id,p_user_id);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_schedule_time_zone_is_known(p_zone text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_zone IS NULL
      OR ((p_zone IN ('UTC', 'GMT')
           OR p_zone ~ '^[A-Z][A-Za-z]+/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+)?$')
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names n WHERE n.name = p_zone))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_tournament_schedule_chat_default()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- TOURNAMENT CHAT IS OFF BY DEFAULT (2026-10-11). The spawner writes
  -- ban_chat = asBool(config.banChat), so an MTT-family config that does not
  -- say is given banChat true here. A Spin or a Sit N Go config, and any
  -- config that says (true or false), is left exactly as written.
  IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.config) = 'object'
     AND COALESCE(NEW.config -> 'banChat', 'null'::jsonb) = 'null'::jsonb
     AND NOT public.fn_ca_schedule_config_keeps_chat(NEW.config) THEN
    NEW.config := jsonb_set(NEW.config, '{banChat}', 'true'::jsonb, true);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_tournament_schedule_board_is_hard_coded()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') IN ('authenticated', 'anon')
     AND (
       (TG_OP <> 'INSERT' AND (OLD.config->>'type' = 'fixed_board' OR OLD.config ? 'fixedBoard'))
       OR (TG_OP <> 'DELETE' AND (NEW.config->>'type' = 'fixed_board' OR NEW.config ? 'fixedBoard'))
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'This event is on the hard coded daily board. Its times are set by the engine and cannot be changed here.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_union_member_schedule_stays_off()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.active AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc
                             WHERE uc.club_id = NEW.club_id AND uc.club_id <> uc.union_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = 'check_violation',
      MESSAGE = 'A club in a union cannot run its own tournament schedule.',
      HINT    = 'Club games stop when a club joins a union; the union runs the schedule.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_schedule_config_keeps_chat(p_config jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_typeof(p_config) = 'object'
     AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(p_config ->> 'type', 'mtt'))) IN ('spin', 'sng', 'hu_sng', 'heads_up')
     AND NOT (
          btrim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_config -> 'satellite_target_id') = 'string' THEN p_config ->> 'satellite_target_id' ELSE '' END) <> ''
       OR btrim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_config -> 'satelliteTargetId') = 'string' THEN p_config ->> 'satelliteTargetId' ELSE '' END) <> ''
       OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM (VALUES (p_config -> 'satellite_target'), (p_config -> 'satelliteTarget')) AS t(v)
             WHERE (jsonb_typeof(t.v) = 'string' AND btrim(t.v #>> '{}') <> '')
                OR (jsonb_typeof(t.v) = 'object'
                    AND (btrim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.v -> 'tournamentId') = 'string' THEN t.v ->> 'tournamentId' ELSE '' END) <> ''
                      OR btrim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.v -> 'tournament_id') = 'string' THEN t.v ->> 'tournament_id' ELSE '' END) <> ''))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_diamond_guarantee_copy(p_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT replace(p_text, 'Chip Guarantee', 'Diamond Guarantee') $function$
